end.gold: Make one thing right tonight, before Isha.

captions: Two streets from the supermarket. You count the change.
“Her mistake, not mine,” you tell yourself.
Tonight she'll count her till. It'll be $10 short.
No camera saw it. But you were never alone.
You walk back in. Same lane. Same tired smile.
You hold out the ten: “I think this is yours.”
She exhales: “You don't know what you just saved me.”
You walk out $10 lighter. Your heart, much lighter.

post.caption:
$10 too much in your change. No one saw. Allah did. 🤍

Honesty is what you do when you think no one is watching. But He always is, and He is near.

“We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein.” (50:16)

Make one thing right tonight, before Isha.
